title: Airbnb welcome message templates: six to copy, and when to send them
summary: Six Airbnb welcome message templates to copy, what to include and leave out, and why the best ones go out within minutes of the booking.
body_markdown:
**The welcome message is the first thing a guest reads from you after they pay. They have just handed over money to a stranger, and they are checking whether that was a good idea. On ProhostAI, the typical welcome message goes out about two minutes after the booking confirms. That is the window. A short, warm message that says what happens next answers the "when do I get the address" and "how does check-in work" questions before they are sent. Below are six welcome message templates you can copy, what each one is for, and the few things a welcome message should never contain.**


*How we measured: the median gap between a booking confirming and its welcome message going out, across 18,559 welcome messages sent by 70 workspaces in the last 12 months, internal workspaces excluded (read-only aggregate of ProhostAI data, November 2026).*
